capabilities: embed YouTube videos in an iframe inside notes
open a timestamped YouTube link in the embedded player via a right-click command
use a dedicated div with id video-player as the iframe container
extras: The README warns that iframes only appear in Reading View when the editing mode is set to Source mode, and explains how to toggle or default to Source mode; installation currently requires manually downloading release files unless the plugin is on the marketplace.
problem: Watching YouTube videos for note-taking requires switching to a browser window, and there is no built-in way to open a video at a specific timestamp inside Obsidian.
summary: Embeds YouTube videos in an iframe inside notes and jumps to specific timestamps when a timestamped YouTube link is clicked.
